## Benedict Leonardi

Data Scientist · 84.51° (84.51 Degrees)\
Ph.D. Candidate in Economics *(on leave)* · University of Cincinnati

---

I work as a data scientist at 84.51°, the data science and analytics subsidiary of Kroger, where I focus on consumer behavior modeling and applied analytics at scale. I am currently on leave from my doctoral program in economics at the University of Cincinnati — where I was a Wolfgang-Mayer Fellow — following the arrival of my first child.

My academic work sits at the intersection of urban economics, spatial analysis, and institutional political economy. I am interested in how the boundaries and structures that govern metropolitan areas — transit authorities, municipal limits, diocesan territories, Fed districts — diverge from the functional economic geographies they nominally represent, and what that divergence costs in welfare terms.
